verdict: Meta has been dark 7 days; paid leads have stopped completely.
narrative: Your Meta ads stopped running on August 6th and have delivered zero spend and zero leads since — this is a campaign pause, not a budget issue, and restoring delivery is the immediate priority. Over the full 28-day window you received 60 leads at $25.69 per lead before the pause hit, so the baseline performance was sound. At the same time, Google Business Profile activity dropped 50% this week, compounding the lead gap on the organic side. Your website sessions are actually up 21% this week driven by organic search, which shows the underlying brand interest is holding. Meta is being reactivated now, and once delivery resumes you should see lead volume return toward the pre-pause pace within days.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all before Meta went dark on August 6th
cost per lead during the active period — a stable baseline to return to
paid leads in the last 7 days while Meta has been paused

watch_item.issue: 60 leads arrived this period but none converted into tracked pipeline opportunities — there appears to be a gap in how incoming leads are being received and followed up on internally.
watch_item.fix: We are reviewing the intake process to identify where leads are falling out before they reach the opportunity stage.
